reigns.note: Son of Poseidon and the nymph Salamis; he slew the island's serpent and, dying childless, left the kingdom to Telamon.
Exiled from Aegina for Phocus' death, he took Salamis and fathered Ajax and, by Hesione, Teucer.
King of Salamis when he led twelve ships to Troy and stood as bulwark of the Achaeans after Achilles' wrath.
